description: 충청북도_재해위험지구 정비사업 현황 [disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 충청북도. 본 데이터는 침수·붕괴·산사태 등 자연재해 위험이 높은 지역을 대상으로 한 정비사업의 재정 투입 현황과 연차별 진행상황을 명확히 보여주어, 지역의 안전관리 수준 및 재난예방 인프라. Coverage: 충청북도. The portal files it under the publisher 충청북도. Its tags are 재난예방, 정비사업, 재해위험지구정비, 재해저감시설, 지역안전관리. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-12-10 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
